thread:
lina_support: Hey team, customer @alex_cust reporting repeated parse failures for JSON mode. They say ~15% of responses are returning malformed JSON or stray text. 

alex_cust: repro steps I ran: 
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"xlarge","mode":"json","input":"summarize: ...","schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}},"required":["summary"]}}' 
Response often looks like: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "summary": "High-level summary about the input..."
} some extra commentary: note about sources
```
so trailing text after the JSON. Also sometimes we get truncated JSON: `{"summary":"...`

lina_support: thanks, this matches other reports. Any quick mitigations we can give?

eng_ml_anya: first-line: recommend client-side sanitizer + robust retry. Two quick patterns: (A) Strict re-ask: if parse fails, re-ask model with a short prompt to output only valid JSON matching schema. (B) Self-heal pass: feed the invalid text to a cleanup prompt asking model to extract/fix the JSON. 

jeff_prod: can you paste example of the re-ask prompt? Ops would like something we can paste into the KB.

eng_ml_anya: sure, something like:
```
"The previous response included extra text or was malformed. Please output ONLY valid JSON that conforms to this schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}},"required":["summary"]}. If you are unable to produce valid JSON, respond with {"error":"UNABLE_TO_FIX"}. Do not include any explanation."
```
This reduces hallucinated commentary.

lina_support: what about automatic regex cleanup? Customers want simple heuristics that avoid a second model call.
\neng_ml_anya: regex can help for common cases: strip leading/trailing non-json tokens, remove trailing commas, and capture the first and last balanced braces. Example sanitizer: 
```
# pseudo-python
text = re.sub(r"^.*?(\{|\[)", r"\1", text, flags=re.S)
# remove non-json trail
text = re.sub(r"(\}|\])[^\}\]]*$", r"\1", text, flags=re.S)
# remove trailing commas before closing braces
text = re.sub(r",(\s*[\}\]])", r"\1", text)
```
Works for ~50-70% cases (trailing commentary, minor comma issues). But don't rely on it for schema drift.

alex_cust: we already tried stripping comments and balanced braces; still seeing cases where the model invents new fields and breaks validation. Any routing/ops side changes?
\njeff_prod: two options: 1) route this customer's requests to a stricter model variant with higher sampling temp=0 and deterministic decoding, or 2) enable JSON mode enforcement at the platform layer (drop non-json token tails and retry automatically). Both have cost/latency tradeoffs.
\nlina_support: can we give a recommended retry/backoff policy? Customers worry about duplicate calls and billing.
\neng_ml_anya: recommended pattern we ship in KB: 
1) Try parse. If parse succeeds and schema validates -> done.
2) If parse fails, attempt lightweight sanitizer (regex) with a 1st immediate attempt (no extra model call). If still fails: 
3) Re-ask model with strict prompt (one additional model call) with header: `system: produce only JSON`. Use deterministic decoding (temp=0), top_p=0.95. 
4) If that re-ask fails, do one self-heal pass (ask model to fix the original mistaken output), then fallback to legacy non-structured output path. 
Backoff: 1st model retry immediate, 2nd model retry after ~500-1000ms random jitter; cap to 2 model retries total to limit cost.

lina_support: include suggested circuit-breaker semantics?
\neng_ml_anya: yes: if >5% of requests in a minute fail JSON post-retries for a customer, circuit-break to non-structured path and alert SRE/Support. Also surface per-request debug logs and sample original output for ML triage.
\njeff_prod: logging/observability note: include these fields on error events: request_id, model_variant, prompt_hash, original_output_snippet (first 2KB), sanitizer_actions_applied, retry_count. SRE wants this for trending.
\nlina_support: billing? Tom, any guidance on chargebacks or credits when we auto-retry?
\ntom_billing: auto-retries count as additional model calls and are billable. For customers on enterprise contracts we can offer a blameless credits program when we detect systemic platform-caused parse failures. For edge-case single-customer model misconfig we recommend support-managed credits case-by-case.
\nalex_cust: ok will try the regex + 1 re-ask flow. Can you add the re-ask and sanitizer snippets to the KB so my engineers can copy them? Also please escalate a sample of 20 failing outputs to eng-ml for model-side analysis.
\nlina_support: will do. @eng_ml_anya can you own the sample triage?
\neng_ml_anya: I'll take it. Please provide: 20 request_ids, original prompts, original outputs, model variant, and timestamps. I'll look for patterns (trailer commentary, partial truncation, or schema drift).
\nlina_support: collecting that now. FYI I'll also add a short playbook to support KB: sanitizer snippet, re-ask prompt, and backoff policy. Marking this for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
\nsre-bot: Incident created: INC-21004 - elevated JSON parse failures for some customers. Pager assigned to eng-oncall.
\nlina_support: closing loop with customer: alex, expect KB update + follow-up by eng-ml within 24 hours. 

alex_cust: thanks, looking forward to it.
